self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Viper's Ballad: Energy Recharge +20/30/40% (R1/R3/R5). Unconditional, so it is auto-applied (no admin toggle) at the leaderboard's chosen refinement for this weapon. Lived in self_modifiers_json at its R5 value until 2026-09-26, when gacha 4* weapons got R1/R3/R5 tiers.

team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Viper's Ballad: three Elemental Skill / Burst hits (0.03s ICD, so one multi-hit cast) convert Hymn of the Pure into Thus Lied the Viper: nearby party members deal +48% Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG for 12s (umbrella key, both Stellar reactions), during which no new stacks accrue. Works off-field. Team scope: reaches the wielder and everyone else. refinementStates carries R1/R3/R5 (R2/R4 read R1/R3); `states` stays the R5 tier.

source.note: 7.1 weapon, added 2026-09-22 (release day) from nanoka 7.1 data; neither Amber nor GO carry it yet. Base stats derived as init x levels['90'] + last ascension add (the derivation validated against the existing seed files for the 7.0 batch). Buffs baked at R5 (house convention: 4* at R5, 5* at R1). The unconditional +40% ER is in self_modifiers_json.

en.flavor: A dark green bow string made out of pure and flawless gemstone. It never fails to summon a warm spring breeze whenever it is drawn.

refinements.1: Increases Energy Recharge by <r>20%</r>. When the equipping character hits the opponent with their Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst, they gain a stack of "Hymn of the Pure." This effect can trigger once every 0.03s, max 3 stacks, and at 3 stacks, all instances of "Hymn of the Pure" are cleared to give the equipping character "Thus Lied the Viper" instead. This grants nearby party members a <r>24%</r> Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG boost for 12s, during which no stacks of "Hymn of the Pure" can be obtained. The aforementioned effects can still trigger even when the equipping character is not on the field.

fr.flavor: Une corde d'arc vert foncé, taillée dans une pierre précieuse pure et sans défaut. Elle évoque immanquablement une douce brise printanière dès qu'on la tire.

refinements.1: La recharge d'énergie augmente de <r>20 %</r>. Lorsque le personnage équipé de l'arme touche un ennemi avec une compétence élémentaire ou un déchaînement élémentaire, il obtient l'effet Hymne de pureté, cet effet pouvant être cumulé 3 fois maximum et déclenché une fois toutes les 0,03 s. Avec 3 cumuls, tout l'hymne de pureté est annulé pour accorder l'effet Mensonge de vipère : augmente les DGT de réaction astrale de tous les personnages de l'équipe à proximité de <r>24 %</r> pendant 12 s, durée pendant laquelle il est impossible d'obtenir à nouveau de l'hymne de pureté. Les effets susmentionnés peuvent être déclenchés même si le personnage équipé de l'arme fait partie de l'équipe mais n'est pas déployé.

pt.flavor: Um arco verde-escuro feito de gemas puras e perfeitas. Sempre invoca uma brisa primaveril quando é retesado.

refinements.1: Aumenta a Recarga de Energia em <r>20%</r>. Quando a Habilidade Elemental ou o Supremo do portador atingem um inimigo, obtém um acúmulo de Canto Sagrado do Purificador. Acumula até 3 vezes, e pode obter 1 acúmulo a cada 0.03s. Ao acumular 3 vezes, remove todos os acúmulos de Canto Sagrado do Purificador para obter Veneno Mortal da Serpente: aumenta o Dano de reações de Brilho Estelar de todos os membros da equipe em <r>24%</r> por 12s. Nesse período não é possível obter mais Canto Sagrado do Purificador. Esse efeito pode ser desencadeado mesmo quando o portador não for o personagem ativo.
